source: Seconds per test, from the list reporter's durations in quality-pr job logs. Each is the mean of its tests there. 'conditions' and the rest: #84's run 39952674962 (job 120410772674, the cells with 11-2's rows) and #89's run 39941643227 (job 120374899100, the perf cells). 'pack' (#20): the tier sentinels, fallback complete on each fixture-* tuple, in runs 40005559234 (jobs 120592517614, 120592517646, 120592517916), 40056077145 (jobs 120759333022, 120759333077, 120759333129) and 40055662895 (jobs 120757997966, 120757997993, 120757998006): nine cells, 203.0 s a cell. 'composition': each composition's complete cell on its published default appearance (kinetic-cosmos, obsidian-atelier, spatial-bento), in run 40066815817 (jobs 120792219276, 120792219294, 120792219316, 120792219322): three cells, about 150 s a cell. 'sweep' (lib/sweep.ts): a swept cell's four rows at 1440x900, until a run that sweeps packs measures them: the default row from 'composition' (a composition's complete cell without the reload conditions) and the others from 'pack'. lib/pr-shards.ts reads it.
